_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 73.3% bottom analog and recovering momentum suggest upward resolution is the base case, but with only 3% of 12h windows showing ±2+ point moves and no breaker yet fired, HOLD is the skilled call — claiming UP requires seeing the liquidity trigger and none has materialized.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both see eventual upward resolution but analyst demands a confirmed breaker (fed_liquidity or ETH ETF flows) while Narrative treats the coiled spring as sufficient; consensus sides with the analyst's higher trust weight and demands evidence before calling direction.
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity lifts above 20 with btc_momentum_30d sustaining above 60 and ETH ETF flows remaining elevated — coordinated risk-on liquidity injection pushing score into Hope (63-70)
next_move.invalidated_if: vix spikes above 22 with dxy breaking 100 and funding flipping negative — risk-off recoil dragging score toward Anxiety (39-46) or Complacency (47-54) floor
